purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: HM Land Registry’s current 2026-09-06 INSPIRE listing names Leicester City Council and its free GML partition. A fresh anonymous download using the site’s ordinary cookie flow returned HTTP 200 (14,594,724 bytes). The archive contains 110,414 complete GML features, updated 2026-10-04, with EPSG:27700 geometry and an INSPIREID field; the dataset documents indicative extents for registered freehold property only. A local, geometry-only scan of a 1 km square centered on the unchanged WUP point found 1,662 complete polygons, including one feature that covers the exact point. Three full nearby polygons are retained with INSPIREID and geometry only; no owner/address fields were read or stored. All 1,662 scanned geometries were valid with unique IDs, and the three retained rings are closed; no repair or clipping was applied.
registryAssessment: HM Land Registry’s current local-authority partition listing explicitly includes Leicester City Council and the GML contains registered freehold index polygons; these are indicative extents, not complete legal boundaries.
